part.text: I'll locate the element representing the role of ArchiMate in the vision regarding cataloguing rules.

query.intent: role of ArchiMate in the vision regarding cataloguing rules 分类编目规则
query.subject: vision

input.cypher: MATCH (e:Element {graphKey: $graphKey}) WHERE toLower(e.name) CONTAINS 'archimate' OR toLower(e.name) CONTAINS '编目' OR toLower(e.name) CONTAINS 'catalogu' RETURN e.id, e.name, e.type
